title: IdentityTripleChangedPayload
description: Payload of the IdentityTripleChanged event, published by masterdata-svc in the transaction of every confirmed identity triple change and consumed by tenancy-svc, which marks the stored certification stale (INV-REQ-1135, INV-AC-16047; ruling INV-Q-16401 option A). The payload carries no triple values. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The entity whose identity triple changed.

constitution.description: The constitution of the changed identity triple.

effectiveFrom.description: The date from which the change is effective.

changeRef.description: Reference of the confirmed identity triple change.
